subject: Re: Clearwave pilot kickoff — temporary pause for QA cycle
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Tanya Lopez <tanya.lopez@clearwave.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 1 Dec 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Clearwave pilot kickoff — scheduling and agenda

Hi Tanya —

Thanks again for taking the time last week. Per our conversation, I pulled together a kickoff agenda and a few calendar windows for the LLM inference pilot demo next week. Headline items: architecture walkthrough, expected latency/cost profiles for your sample queries, and a short hands-on test with your QA team.

Proposed slots (PT):
- Tue 12/7 10:00–11:00
- Wed 12/8 14:00–15:00
- Thu 12/9 09:00–10:00

I've attached a one-page MAP and the provisional agenda (Clearwave-MAP-v1.pdf). If any of these conflict with your sprint milestones, tell me what works and we'll adapt.

Thanks,
Hannah Schmitt
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0187

Attachment stubs: Clearwave-MAP-v1.pdf (PDF, 120KB)

From: Tanya Lopez <tanya.lopez@clearwave.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: engineering@clearwave.ai
Date: Wed, 1 Dec 2027 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Clearwave pilot kickoff — scheduling and agenda

Hi Hannah —

Appreciate the follow-up and the clear agenda. Quick update from our side: we've just had the QA org scope the release candidate for the quarter and they're taking the next two sprints to run an expanded regression cycle. That pulls a bunch of engineering and product resources (including the folks we'd planned to have at the demo) into test and triage work.

Also, two of our leads are traveling during the 12/7–12/9 window for a vendor review. Given the resource squeeze + the timing risk, we need to pause the demo kickoff for now. We still want to evaluate Redwood — this is a postponement, not a no — but we don't have a reliable timeline yet.

Would you be okay if we park the kickoff and revisit in mid-January after the release stabilizes? If so, can you send a one-pager we can share with the QA leads that highlights what they'd see in the hands-on test (sample queries, what we need from them, and the minimal data/access required)?

Thanks,
Tanya Lopez
Director of Product, Clearwave
Tanya.Lopez@clearwave.ai

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Tanya Lopez <tanya.lopez@clearwave.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 2 Dec 2027 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Clearwave pilot kickoff — scheduling and agenda

Tanya —

Totally understand and thanks for the context. Mid-Jan sounds reasonable; I put a tentative follow-up reminder into our internal pipeline and will reach back the week of 1/11 to see where things stand.

I'll attach a concise one-pager for your QA leads that outlines the hands-on test scope, the lightweight data/access we need, and expected time commitment (we can do a gated test that doesn't require wide access). Expect that in your inbox by EOD today.

For internal tracking, Jordan/Marissa: tagging you both so we can: 1) update the nurture timeline in HubSpot, 2) move the kickoff from "active" to "paused — prospect reprioritized", and 3) schedule a check-in cadence (we typically reach out at 6 and 12 weeks). Jordan, can you add a follow-up task for 2028-01-12 and drop the planning calendar (planning-calendar.ics) into the deal notes? Marissa, want to flag for potential discount window expiry if this slips into Q1.

Thanks — we'll keep the momentum but honor their runway.

Best,
Hannah
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 3 Dec 2027 11:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Clearwave pilot kickoff — scheduling and agenda

Noted. I added the HubSpot task (deal CW-2027-Q4-1294) and uploaded the planning calendar to the deal record. Follow-up steps I recorded:
- 2028-01-12: outreach touchpoint (Hannah)
- 2028-01-26: second check-in if no response (Jordan)
- Nurture sequence: 6-week technical note + 10-week ROI case study

Marissa — I'll mark the opportunity stage as "paused — resource constraint" and flag for potential deal timing reset. If leadership wants to keep Q4 pricing hold, let me know and I'll request an internal exception.

—Jordan
Solutions Engineer (Sales Ops), Redwood Inference
Attachment stub: planning-calendar.ics (calendar invite)
